name: frp-client-manager
title: frp Client Manager
description: Manage a local frp client (frpc): service control, proxies, logs, config hot-reload, and version upgrades.
author: DanielZHAO

commands.name: status
commands.title: View Status
commands.subtitle: frp
commands.description: Dashboard for the frpc process, admin API, proxies, and version updates.

commands.name: proxies
commands.title: Manage Proxies
commands.subtitle: frp
commands.description: List frpc proxies from the config with live admin API status.

commands.name: logs
commands.title: View Logs
commands.subtitle: frp
commands.description: Read the frpc log with level filters.

commands.name: menu-bar
commands.title: frp Menu Bar
commands.description: Menu bar extra showing frpc status and proxy counts.

preferences.name: frpDir
preferences.title: frp Directory
preferences.description: Root directory that contains frpc.toml, logs, and versioned frpc binaries.

preferences.name: launchdLabel
preferences.title: launchd Label
preferences.description: Label of the LaunchAgent that runs frpc (e.g. com.user.frpc). Leave empty if frpc is not managed by launchd.

preferences.name: adminAddr
preferences.title: Admin API Address
preferences.description: Host:port of the frpc admin (webServer) API.

preferences.name: adminUser
preferences.title: Admin Username
preferences.description: Basic Auth username for the frpc admin API.

preferences.name: adminPassword
preferences.title: Admin Password
preferences.description: Basic Auth password for the frpc admin API. Leave empty to skip live status.
